minimum_lands_applies_to: Every kept hand, including the original seven and the final hand after London bottoming
floor_status: Methodological proposal, not a player-selected rule; failures are retained in every unconditional denominator

policy_definitions.min_two: Keep any hand with at least two lands after bottoming. No other rejection criterion in this control policy.
policy_definitions.seek_boulder_once: At seven require at least two lands and Boulder; after the first mulligan require only at least two lands. At most one voluntary mulligan for missing Boulder.

bottom_policy: From legal subsets retain a Boulder plus an untapped land if possible, then a first Boulder, then aim for 3 lands at sizes >=5 or 2 below, then color breadth, fewer duplicate Boulders, draw spells and threats; deterministic name/order tiebreak. No hidden-library information.

land_families.description: Citadel reemplaza una tierra negra enderezada

balance_policy: For 20 lands / 4 Boulder cut one Nihil Spellbomb. Fill slots freed by fewer Boulder with Nihil Spellbomb up to 4, then Myr Enforcer up to 4, then Glint Hawk up to 4.
limitations: Only opening hands and London mulligans: no turn simulation, scry, extra draws, affinity payments or opposing hate.
Boulder plus an untapped land in hand means a potential T1 cast without interaction, not an operational filter on T1.
The same seed per trial shares shuffle randomness across cells; no paired-difference confidence interval or winner is claimed.
Basic lands, the other bridge pairs and additional Citadel counts are planned extensions, not tested by this first pilot.
